_comment: De-PII'd /v1/user/info for hermetic /gpus-console/jobs. /gpus-console/jobs is in LOGIN_REQUIRED_URL, so without a logged-in user the console Header (useHeaderAuth) redirects to /user/login. uuid present keeps the session logged-in; teams:[] -> currentTeam=null (updateUserInfo requires teams to be an array). All identifying fields are synthetic placeholders — no real PII / tokens.
